description: Revise existing text or draft natural prose in multiple languages, using 12 writing rules while preserving meaning and factual accuracy.

defaultPrompt: Humanize this text while preserving its meaning, facts, and voice.
Draft clear, natural writing from my brief.
Rewrite this in its original language without formulaic phrasing.
interface.longDescription: Revise user-provided text or generate new writing from a brief. Applies the user's 12 writing rules with exemptions for meaning, facts, quotations, terminology, and language conventions. Supports multilingual prose and preserves the author's voice. No AI-detector guarantees.

name: humanize-ai-writing
